subject: Nebula Analytics — AWS co-sell intake & sprint wrangle
content:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro request — Nebula Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Hi Rachel / Laura,

Quick context: Nebula Analytics (startup in logistics analytics) just finished a successful pilot with a subset of their customers and is evaluating a production deployment. Amy Hart (AWS Partner Manager) flagged them as a good co-sell candidate and asked us to run a short mutual action plan + intro call to align procurement, security, and scope.

What I need from you: can Rachel own the intro + MA plan kickoff? Key asks for the initial call:
- Walk through a 30-min solution overview (we'll demo a pre-recorded flow)
- Confirm security evidence they require (SOC2, data retention, encryption)
- Agree an MA timeline (PO/contract milestones, pilot -> GA)

External contacts: Emma Yang (emma.yang@nebulaanalytics.com) — Head of Platform, Josh Walters (josh.walters@nebulaanalytics.com) — CTO.

I attached a blank MA template to use as the working doc. Happy to join the call if helpful.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Sales Director
Redwood Inference

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Emma Yang <emma.yang@nebulaanalytics.com>, Josh Walters <josh.walters@nebulaanalytics.com>, Amy Hart <amy.hart@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request — Nebula Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Thanks Karthik — happy to run point.

Emma / Josh — great to meet you (virtually). Per Karthik's note, we'd like to do a 30–40 minute kickoff to:
- Align on success criteria for a co-sell engagement
- Capture security & procurement checkpoints into an MA plan
- Agree timeline and owners for a short pilot

Suggested times (PST):
- Thu 2026-11-07 10:00–10:40
- Thu 2026-11-07 14:00–14:40
- Fri 2026-11-08 11:00–11:40

I'm CCing Sean (channel lead) and Laura (catalog/listing + procurement) so we can cover partner/delivery details. I attached: nebula_ma_plan_v1.xlsx (MA plan template) and nebula_security_checklist.pdf (short checklist we typically ask customers to fill). Could you confirm which time works and whether you need anything else (arch diagram, SOC2 reports)?

Next steps I will take after we agree a time:
- Create the MA plan and assign initial owners
- Share a short pre-read (arch + one-page value brief)
- Add HubSpot record link and roadmap items

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive, Partners
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nebula_ma_plan_v1.xlsx, nebula_security_checklist.pdf

---

From: Emma Yang <emma.yang@nebulaanalytics.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Josh Walters <josh.walters@nebulaanalytics.com>, Amy Hart <amy.hart@amazon.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T08:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request — Nebula Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Hi Rachel — thanks for reaching out. Thursday 11/7 14:00 PST works best for our team. We're excited to chat.

Quick answers to your asks:
- SOC2: we have a Type II report (can provide a redacted copy) — need to confirm NDA path for sharing.
- Architecture: I attached a two-page architecture summary (stub: nebula_arch_summary.pdf) and our primary AWS account id in aws_account_id.txt.
- Procurement: we typically need 60 days for a PO if terms are standard; if you can share a sample MSA that speeds things up.

We will dial in from 14:00 PST using the Zoom link listed in the invite.

Thanks,
Emma Yang
Head of Platform
Nebula Analytics

Attachments: aws_account_id.txt, nebula_arch_summary.pdf (attachment stub)

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Emma Yang <emma.yang@nebulaanalytics.com>, Josh Walters <josh.walters@nebulaanalytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T11:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request — Nebula Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Nice — confirmed for Thu 2026-11-07 14:00–14:40 PST. Calendar invite sent (Zoom).

Pre-read and links:
- MA plan (draft): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bNebula-MAPlan
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/NEB-98312
- Sample MSA (redlines tolerated): https://drive.google.com/sample-msas/redwood-sample-ms

Agenda (30–40 min):
1) Intros & objectives (5 min) — Emma / Josh + Redwood team
2) Solution overview & demo highlights (10 min) — pre-recorded + Q&A
3) Security & procurement checklist (10 min) — Laura to note blockers
4) Next steps & owners / timeline (5 min)

Action owners (initial):
- Rachel: MA plan owner, meeting facilitation, HubSpot updates
- Laura: procurement + catalogue listing path, sample MSA point of contact
- Sean: channel follow-up and AWS partner coordination
- Karthik: executive champion / commercial runway

If you can drop SOC2 redacted and the primary contact for procurement into the MA plan before the call that would help speed the pilot kickoff.

Thanks everyone — looking forward.

Cheers,
Rachel

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro request — Nebula Analytics (AWS co-sell)

Quick internal note post-kickoff: the call went well — Nebula is sold on the value prop but will require a short security review and a procurement timeline. Marcus, can you review the MA plan draft and add a catalog listing checklist (I started a few entries in the Drive folder)?

Also flagged: Nebula asked about marketplace listing timing if the pilot proves out. We should map out a 6–8 week timeline for listing + marketing enablement if the pilot converts. I added a few stub items to the HubSpot record.

Laura
Program Manager, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Quoted thread preserved above for records.
